rule: This outer record identifies the exact allowlisted release-safe payload envelope, its canonical member-manifest digest, all three physically distinct exact-commit review reports whose machine-readable metadata matches approving detached dispositions with no unresolved blocker, the raw bytes of every execution artifact, queue metadata, and every runtime-critical file byte and Git mode as read directly from content_commit before OSF submission. The confirmatory-only branch also requires the manifest's Ollama activation_decision to be not-activated and every pre-outcome flag to remain false. Every queue uses exactly the count fields sequence_system_trials, review_boundaries, review_boundaries_by_system, and review_boundaries_by_decomposition. The payload excludes both detached state records, executable cases, credentials, account state, attempts, results, raw provider output, and reasoning traces. This record never authorizes outcome calls.
